title: Geometric points lift along a finite morphism (over every point of the fibre)
statement: Let $\pi:Y'\to Y$ be a finite morphism of schemes [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], let $\bar y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point] ($\Omega$ an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure]) lying over $y\in Y$, and let $y'\in Y'$ be a point with $\pi(y')=y$. Then there is a geometric point $\bar y':\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y'$ (with the same field $\Omega$) lying over $y'$ such that $\pi\circ\bar y'=\bar y$. In particular, if $\pi$ is moreover surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism], then every geometric point of $Y$ lifts along $\pi$ to a geometric point of $Y'$ with the same field.
